title: SIMLYFE
shortDescription: Shape a life through careers, relationships and AI-driven choices.
fullDescription:
Every life has a story. Shape yours in SIMLYFE, a life simulation where choices, consequences and AI-driven events move your character forward.

Start a fictional life and explore education, careers, relationships, health, pets and finances. Advance through the years, respond to unexpected situations and see your choices become part of your life history.

Build a career. Balance relationships. Grow a portfolio. Discover new activities and opportunities as your character ages. Simulated money, assets and gambling stay inside the game.

Play as a guest, or link an account for cloud saves across devices. AI-generated events require an internet connection. Events can be reported inside the app, and account-deletion requests are available through Account and the web deletion page.

SIMLYFE contains mature fictional themes. The proposed target audience is adults; the final store rating will be assigned through the content-rating questionnaire. Account support and privacy details must be finalized before distribution.
